_comment: F1 2026-10-07 (f-designer). studio:design fish/targets (alias spec/fish-numbers). Report: _bmad-output/research/domain-fish-2026-10-07/research.md s7. Bands are defined by BED DEPTH only (ruling/fish-depth-bands); densityPerM2 = adultsPer100m / (100 * nominalWidth). Distances and speeds in game m (player scale, not halved). Depths are below the local surface (WaterLevelY + WaterMotion.Offset) unless named bed*. Per-fish and per-school event rates are calibration starting values; the acceptance targets are the totals in sightings. JsonUtility-friendly.

visibility.cullRule: FishMurk (f-td cull of record): not drawn when (1-F)*Tavg < 0.02 at the shallowest point of the body; path L = d / max(V.y, 0.15); extinction 2.2/2.4/3.2 per m
visibility.tierRule: ruling/fish-visibility-tiers: FishMurk only decides drawn / not drawn and never overrides tiers. V1: body reads only within 0.6 m; deeper but inside the floor = dim shadow at most. V2: shadow or flash at most at ANY depth, never a body. V3: never drawn (neverDrawBody). Bluff stays surface-only via R_sub.
visibility.measuredSecchiNote: f-designer n=572 (CHE stations, numeric metre/foot rows); f-web n=624 (all HUC 05130202 rows): both median 1.0 m, p10-p90 0.7-1.2 m
visibility.jumpBodyRule: A jumping body at or above the surface is drawn out to 40 m (exempt from R_sub 25 m, which governs sub-surface bodies). It counts as part of its jump surface event, not toward maxVisibleBodies. Applies from the bluff too (a fish in the air is a surface sign, N2). Beyond 40 m: splash/ring sign only.

limits.minBedDepthRule: per species: minBedDepth >= bedClearance + surfaceMargin + 0.028 (wave amplitude) + body height at max scale, rounded up to 0.05 m. estBodyHeightMax is my estimate (depth/TL ratio x tail max x 1.1); if f-artist clip-max boxes are taller, FishTuning.Validate wins and minBedDepth rises to fit (record it as a revision).
limits.clearanceNote: bedClearance and surfaceMargin are per species (small shelf species 0.08/0.05, gar bask 0.03, others 0.15/0.10), each plus half body height

bands.note: Census area = bed depth 0-2 m (nominal 7 m wide); fish are placed only where bed >= each species minBedDepth (global floor 0.35 m)

FINAL (team-lead; f-td ruling/fish-depth-bands rev 4, option A): open = bed >= 9.9 m AND LevelMaps shore distance <= 50 m (valid south of the line, test-guarded). Beyond 50 m: no fish and no fish-driven signs. Shelf and ramp stay depth-only. Density per m2 unchanged. Changes to the open band only via team-lead.
bands.farWaterRule: ruling/fish-far-water-signs: beyond outerShoreDistance 50 m, south of the line, inside surfaceEventRadius 150 m: sign-only events at the open band's per-area rate x bandRateMultiplier (frozen 1.00; no new tunable). Events carry fishId -1 / class farWater; no fish state beyond 50 m. No fish, bodies, shadows or jumps. Kinds Rise/Swirl/Dimple only; far signs flagged in the event record. Soft muted L4 rings fading with distance. Deterministic per (seed, cell, tick); nearer events win when the 6-live-sign cap binds; any refusal of a sign within 60 m of the shore eye because of far signs is a finding (refusals reported by origin). F7 JSON reports far/near counts and cap-binding share separately. If F8/qa finds it busy, cut this rate first.

species.lookNote: L1 (ruling/fish-roster-look): long dark shadow under the surface while basking, plus snout/back dimple, slow V-wake and a sink swirl; never a lit body

structure.note: R3: slack side of the face takes part of the former lee allocation (carp, gar, buffalo)

sightings.definition: Body: a fish or school in the camera frustum, within subSurfaceDrawRadius, drawable by FishMurk and not terrain-occluded from the eye, continuously for >= minSightingSec; it recounts only after bodyRecountSec out of view. Surface event: a sign (rise, dimple, swirl, V-wake, nervous water, roll/tail, gar gulp/bask, jump, busting) whose origin is in the frustum, within surfaceEventViewRadius and not terrain-occluded, counted once at spawn. Sightings = bodies + surface events; a flee wake is a surface event, and a body seen together with its own wake counts once.
sightings.routeShore: f-level shore-routes.json robertson_mccord: bank st 1410->1585 every 5th, 6 m inland, 903 m, teleport start (1077.9,-49.6), 5 m/s, eye 1.7 m, yaw = travel direction + 35 deg toward the water; same route at 3 seeds
sightings.routeBluff: Geometric (team-lead final rule of record), applied identically at BOTH bluffs: McCord (P0 = LM_McCordBluff XZ 401.36, 717.27; McCord anchor) and Buzzard (P0 = LM_BuzzardBluff XZ 413.84, 1793.19; Buzzard anchor). n = unit horizontal bank normal (toward water) of that anchor at the bank station nearest P0 (landed anchor asset). March from P0 along n in 0.5 m steps using TryGroundHeight throughout: E = last sample whose ground >= ground(P0) - 1.0 m (still on the crest; f-qa fix); F = first sample with ground <= WaterLevelY (fail loudly if none within 200 m); d_F = |F - E| horizontal. vFOV read from the game camera at run time. Eye = (E.x, height(E) + 1.7, E.z); yaw = n; h = eye.y - WaterLevelY; pitch down = atan2(h, d_F) - vFOV/2 + 3 deg (foot waterline 3 deg inside the bottom of the frame). 180 s per bluff. Graded at seeds 101/202/303, each bluff within T13 1.2-3.0 surface events/min (near + far combined), 0 sub-surface body draws from either bluff. Held-out 404/505/606 information only. Frozen once written; untuned.
sightings.bluffExpectedNote: Graded band 2.0/min (1.2-3.0) in view within 150 m of the McCord landmark; with fish only within 50 m of the bank, expected ~1.3-1.8/min. F8 lever if low or empty-looking mid-river: a sign-only far-water event rate (retune), not a wider band.
sightings.legibilityRule: A sign counts toward F7/bluff only within legibleDistanceByKind for the eye (0 = never). Source: TestResults/fish-lookdev/sign-legibility.json (slot #18, valid, sha256 702eea92...; f-qa plan rev 4.2 floor: minor axis >= 6 px at 1080 lines, Weber >= 0.05 linear Rec.709, same frame). Per cell the minimum of three independent derivations (f-designer JSON, f-designer pixel recompute, f-qa image diff). signRendered = false points are NOT MEASURED (never raise or lower); f-artist: shore >= 60 m are sub-pixel and age 0.9 faded (measured fails), Buzzard 60 m occluded by a tree at the F16 pose. NOTES (not values): (1) GarBask = 0 everywhere comes from the vertical-extent size criterion on a long thin body line; f-qa images found its changed region >= 6 px at shore 15 m and Buzzard 30 m; stays 0 for grading, flagged for Noah F8 and f-director. (2) FLAGGED: Wake/shore 30 (some 10 m and 15 m shots unrendered). NervousWater/McCord 60 and Busting/McCord 60 not flagged: no lower McCord point is unrendered (McCord 30 m: 0/55 unrendered). (3) Buzzard column PROVISIONAL pending f-artist's Buzzard 60 m re-measure off the tree line (f-qa rev 5.7; + projectedHeightPx, occludedBy), which includes the Wake/Buzzard 100 flag; a change is a separate revision with f-qa agreement. Rates and sizes unaffected (ruling/fish-sign-legibility-distance).

scatter.dryPlayerTriggers: yes: shelf fish within triggerBankWalk of the feet while the player is within bankWalkLipDistance of the waterline
scatter.reactionTurnRule: 720 deg/s applies only inside the logged startle window (trigger to +reactionTimeMax 0.4 s); outside it the species burst/cruise caps govern; <= 45 deg/frame always (F5)

sim.spawnRule: cells live inside bodySimRadiusIn, dead outside bodySimRadiusOut; population is a pure function of (seed, cell); a cell is live only where TryGroundHeight succeeds; bodies fade in over 1 s and only spawn where not drawable (outside R_sub or below the FishMurk floor), so nothing pops in view

structureRules: Anchors per f-level sections/level-structure-anchors.md: McCord, Buzzard and unnamed bluff faces (hanging hollows folded in); Cleeces Ferry landing; slipway; Robertson Island river face st 1408-1522 (592 m) + south chute mouth st 1404-1412 + north chute mouth st 1518-1526 at (658.9,347.9) (the dry chute holds no fish); real hollow mouths st 1543, 1669, 52, 107 (+16 near the line). Structure area = anchor shoreline x 0-20 m out, banded by bed depth like everywhere. Adults = densityMultiplier x band density x area; mix = band mix x prefs weight, renormalised; flathead added on top (structure-only species). No structure fish swims deeper than its bed allows (ruling/fish-robertson-island-anchor). The game has no snag geometry, so there are no snag anchors.

animation.animRateRule: clip rate = max(idleAnimRate, idleAnimRate + speed / (strideBodyLengths * bodyLength)) <= maxRate
animation.note: strideBodyLengths 0.7 per Swim cycle is f-artist INFERRED; if F1 measurement moves it, burst caps move with it (revision)
animation.burstRule: burstSpeed <= 8.5 x lengthMin, so idleAnimRate + burst / (0.7 x lengthMin) <= maxRate 12.5 (f-td RateCoversBurst); cap the speed, not the rate

countingRule: adultsPer100m / densityPerM2 count individual adults including white bass; shad and skipjack schools are excluded and counted only as school units

No density or sighting target changed.

If F8 bluff look reads empty mid-river, add a sign-only far-water event rate (retune lever) rather than widening the band.

Open band F3 target restated as 17.8 adults/ha +-25% over all open water; open surface events 0.67/ha/min (= old 0.2 per 100 m over 3,000 m2); open schools per ha (shad 3.0, skipjack 1.2). F9 2026-10-07: f-td design call: jumping bodies above the surface drawn to 60 m (jumpBodyDrawRadius), exempt from R_sub; counted as the jump event, not a body. No other change.
F10 2026-10-07: jumpBodyDrawRadius 60 -> 40 (f-td option a): live cells start at 50 m and must extend >= 10 m past any draw radius; avoids raising the sim radius (web cost). No other change.
F11 2026-10-07: LongnoseGar jumpPerFishPerMin 0.002 -> 0 to match ruling/fish-airborne-jumps; added jumpSpecies list and jumpRule text. Issued before slot B at team-lead request. No other change.

FishTuning.Validate with f-artist's FishBodies (need = clearance + max(margin, 0.028) + 0.028 + body height at lengthTailMax): CommonCarp minBedDepth 0.45 -> 0.55 (need 0.528), LongnoseGar 0.35 -> 0.40 (need 0.351), LargemouthBass 0.40 -> 0.45 (need 0.400, float edge). No other change.

Also F3 target defects from slot B: SpottedBass depthMin 2.0 -> 1.0, minBedDepth 2.0 -> 1.3 (shelf placement was impossible: needed bed >= 2.23 m on a 0-2 m band); WhiteCrappie depthMin 1.5 -> 0.8, minBedDepth 1.0 -> 1.2 (only ~16% of the shelf was usable). jumpRule: ruling/fish-airborne-jumps rev 2 + ruling/fish-airborne-jumps-skipjack: only CommonCarp and SkipjackHerring leave the water. airborneBodyAllowed overrides neverDrawBody only while the fish is at or above the surface during its own logged jump (underwater skipjack stays V3).
